name: Sun Cleric: Blazing Chariot already boosts Radiance's healing and damage by 125% (#1574)
contract: 300350 is ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (aura 108), MiscValue 0 = SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, EffectSpellClassMask word 0 = 0x80000000. Radiance's cast spell (800038) carries that exact bit in its own SpellFamilyFlags word 0 (0x80000000, a top-bit encoding). SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod's generic flag96 AND matches. BasePoints 124 resolves to 125 (DieSides 1), matching 'Increases the healing and damage of Radiance by 125%'. SPELLMOD_DAMAGE is applied inside both Unit::SpellHealingBonusDone (effect 0, SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL) and Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone (effect 1, SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE), which is why the same modifier boosts both halves of a hybrid heal/damage spell. Native only, no server code needed.
